content.title: UPLD Q3 Deep Dive: AI-Driven Deal Momentum Amid Declining Revenue and Focused Portfolio
content.summary: Cloud software provider Upland Software (NASDAQ:UPLD) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales fell by 24.2% year on year to $50.53 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $49.4 million was less impressive, coming in 2.7% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.30 per share was 73.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
